selection.rule: D11: mean cluster-balanced AUC over {TOUGH-M1-dev L, TOUGH-M1-dev D, BLiPS-val L, BLiPS-val D}, raw cosine; one-SE rule (SE = sd of the replicate-wise mean of the four bootstrap replicates; TOUGH-M1 and BLiPS bootstrapped independently; within a dataset L and D share replicate weights); simplest = fewest dims, ties -> earlier grid entry
